short: Articulatory route works on vocalized EMG but trails the mel baseline on WER; it exists for ECoG since 2019, and the electrode subset is never tested against equal-size alternatives.
position: The paper changes the EMG-to-speech intermediate target to audio-inverted articulatory features (M06) and proposes an electrode subset from feature associations (M05); both are standard. Intelligibility trails the mel-spectrogram baseline (WER 15.5% vs 12.6% for the paper's re-scored baseline), and the SpeechBERTScore gain comes with a different synthesizer (HiFi-GAN for the baseline, an articulatory synthesizer with an external speaker embedding for the proposed route), so the representation is not isolated. The average correlation of 0.9 for EMA and loudness is against pseudo-labels inverted from the same audio. The subset is not compared with searched or random subsets of equal size and ranked 5th of 70 in a later exhaustive test. Silent EMG, seeds and the interval construction are absent.
